hook.text: Dad brought you here 300 Saturdays. How many du'as did he get?

verses.text: “Call upon Me; I will respond to you.”

end.text: Dad brought you here 300 Saturdays. How many du'as did he get?
end.gold: Tonight at Isha: one du'a, just for him. Then call him.

captions: 5:40 p.m. The old library. First time in 15 years.
Same green lamps. Same smell of old paper.
Inside a children's book: a card. Your name, in his handwriting.
He's 68 now. His hands shake when he writes.
Your phone buzzes. “Dad: Did you eat today, son?”
He still checks on you. Do you ever mention him to Allah?
Isha at the mosque. After the salam, your hands rise.
The first name you say tonight is his.
Then you text back: “I ate, Dad. See you Saturday.”

post.caption:
Dad brought you here 300 Saturdays. How many du'as did he get? 🤍

He taught you to read. He still asks if you've eaten. The least we can do: name him in front of Allah.

“Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” (40:60)

Tonight at Isha: one du'a, just for him. Then call him.
